_how_to_edit: These are the photos visitors can piece together. Put your own photos in public/media/ (landscape photos work best — they are cropped to 4:3) and change "src" to e.g. "/media/my-trip.jpg". Give every photo a unique "id". Set "placeholder" to false once a photo is really yours — until then a 'placeholder photo' ribbon is shown.
